integrity: A direct proof and a reproducible finite-field sanity-check script are included. The literature search is not exhaustive. Independent audit and independent validation have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the one-variable algebra F_q[x]/(x^m), m>=2. It does not classify derivation orbits, Jordan forms, or multivariable cases. Finite checks cover listed prime fields only; the proof is symbolic for all finite fields.
title: Exact rank spectrum of derivations of a truncated polynomial algebra
